# Membrane H264 FFmpeg plugin v0.32.7 - Table of Contents

> Membrane H264 decoder and encoder based on FFmpeg and x264

## Pages

- [Membrane H264 FFmpeg plugin](https://membrane-h264-ffmpeg-plugin.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

## Modules

- [Membrane.H264.FFmpeg.Decoder](https://membrane-h264-ffmpeg-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.H264.FFmpeg.Decoder.md): Membrane element that decodes video in H264 format. It is backed by decoder from FFmpeg.
- [Membrane.H264.FFmpeg.Encoder](https://membrane-h264-ffmpeg-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.H264.FFmpeg.Encoder.md): Membrane element that encodes raw video frames to H264 format.
